verdict.rationale: Evidence indirectly supports WebSocket handling: Cloudflare explicitly bills for 'hibernating WebSockets' (cloudflare-docs-15) and the Agents SDK/Durable Objects model advertises 'built-in support for real-time communication' with persistent, stateful execution environments that hibernate and wake on demand (cloudflare-supp-agents-sdk, cloudflare-docs-32). However, a 2022 developer comment notes WebSockets were still 'in beta' at the time (cloudflare-comm-4), and no dedicated first-party WebSocket API docs are present in the pack. Missing for 10: dedicated WebSocket API/durable-object docs describing connection lifecycle and limits, independent hands-on confirmation of production-grade stability, and resolution of the historical beta-status concern.
